name: enhance_add_approval_gate
prompt: Add a manual_input step to this playbook that asks the analyst to confirm before the IP is blocked -- a Confirm and a Cancel button. Leave everything else exactly as it is.
notes: Phase 3: enhancement quality. The judge (verify_enhancement's regressions) already existed and the matrix never read it, so an edit that dropped a step or silently renamed one scored exactly as well as a surgical one. Three gates count and each catches a different real failure: `behavior` (the gate was actually added, ahead of the block), `no_collateral_damage` (Enrich IP / Block IP / End survive with their names), `enhance_delivery` (the edit reached the playbook instead of being typed into chat -- the live failure this scenario set was written from).

ir_assertions.note: Confirm AND Cancel, not one button
P2: the block is now downstream of the analyst, not beside them
